map.根据光源光通量、距离与展柜面积计算照度(lux)，并对照文物照度限值核查是否合规: Compute illuminance (lux) from source luminous flux, distance and showcase area, check compliance against artifact illuminance limits, and give adjustment advice if exceeded.
map.展柜布灯时，按灯具数量、光通量、利用系数与玻璃透过率估算总有效光通，用平均照度法: When lighting a showcase, estimate total effective luminous flux from lamp count, luminous flux, utilization factor and glass transmittance, and use the average illuminance method E = Φ/A to check whether exhibit illuminance limits are exceeded.
map.重点照明设计（射灯）时，用点光源中心照度 E=I/d² 与光斑直径评估打光效果，: When designing accent lighting (spotlights), use point source center illuminance E = I/d² and spot diameter to evaluate the lighting effect, avoiding local overexposure or too small a spot.
map.等级敏感展品（书画/丝绸高敏感）布光时，对照 GB/T 23863-2009 限: When lighting grade-sensitive exhibits (calligraphy and silk are highly sensitive), check against GB/T 23863-2009 limits (highly sensitive 50 lx, low/medium sensitivity 150 lx, insensitive 300 lx) and dim or add filters if needed.
map.：某展柜 4 盏 LED（单盏 500 lm、光束角 36°、利用系数 0.7）: : a showcase with 4 LEDs (500 lm each, beam angle 36°, utilization factor 0.7), glass transmittance 100%, area 10 m², 2 m from the exhibit, highly sensitive (limit 50 lx). Total effective luminous flux = 4 × 500 × 0.7 × 1.0 = 1400 lm; average illuminance = 1400 ÷ 10 = 140 lx; solid angle = 2π(1 − cos18°) ≈ 0.307 sr, single lamp intensity ≈ 350 ÷ 0.307 ≈ 1138 cd, center illuminance ≈ 1138 ÷ 4 × 4 ≈ 1138 lx; spot diameter = 2 × 2 × tan18° ≈ 1.30 m. Conclusion: the 140 lx average far exceeds the 50 lx limit for high sensitivity, so dimming is required (lower lumen source / dimming / filters).
map.依据 GB/T 23863-2009《博物馆照明设计规范》：高敏感展品（书画、丝: Per GB/T 23863-2009 'Code for lighting design of museum': highly sensitive exhibits (calligraphy, silk and similar) at most 50 lx with annual exposure at most 150,000 lx·h; low/medium sensitivity at most 150 lx; insensitive at most 300 lx. Lighting must match exhibit sensitivity.
map.平均照度与中心照度为何差很多？: Why do average and center illuminance differ so much?
map.平均照度 E=总光通÷面积反映整体亮度；中心照度 E=I/d² 反映射灯光斑中心: Average illuminance E = total luminous flux ÷ area reflects overall brightness; center illuminance E = I/d² reflects the spot center peak of a spotlight (point source falls with the square of distance). The spot center is often far above the average, so accent lighting must control both to avoid local overexposure damaging artifacts.

map.这个工具怎么用？: How do I use this tool?

map.展柜照度计算 使用指南 - ToolBox: Showcase Illuminance Calculator User Guide - ToolBox
map.按整数灯具数量、单盏光通量、距离与展柜面积计算平均照度与中心照度，并对照文物照度: Calculate average and center illuminance from an integer lamp count, luminous flux per lamp, distance and case area, then check against artifact limits. A fractional lamp count or a 180° beam angle is rejected to avoid truncation and an infinite spot.
map.平均照度用总有效光通量除以面积；中心照度按点光源 E=I/d² 计算，其中光强由: Average illuminance is total effective flux divided by area. Center illuminance uses the point-source E=I/d², with intensity derived from flux per lamp and beam solid angle. Lamp count must be an integer above 0, so 1.9 is not truncated to one lamp. Beam angle must be above 0 and below 180°, because tan(90°) is undefined and the spot-diameter formula fails at 180°. Both average and center illuminance must stay below the selected sensitivity limit.
map.书画柜布灯前核对平均照度与中心峰值是否都低于 50 lx。: Before lighting a painting case, check that both average and peak center illuminance are below 50 lx.
map.比较 4 盏与 6 盏 LED 的照度差异，决定是否调光。: Compare four versus six LED lamps to decide whether dimming is needed.
map.发现中心照度远高于平均时，加大照射距离或加柔光片。: When center illuminance far exceeds average, increase the distance or add a diffuser.
map.选择光源类型，带出单盏光通量与光束角预设。: Choose a lamp type to load its flux and beam-angle preset.
map.填写整数光源数量、距离、利用系数、展柜面积与玻璃透过率。: Enter integer lamp count, distance, utilization factor, case area and glass transmittance.
map.选择展品敏感等级，查看平均照度、中心照度、光斑直径与限值。: Choose the artifact sensitivity class and review average illuminance, center illuminance, spot diameter and limit.
map.任一指标超标时按建议减灯、换低光通光源或调光。: If any metric exceeds the limit, reduce lamps, switch to lower-flux lamps or dim as advised.
map.4 盏 500 lm、36°、利用系数 0.7、透过率 100%、面积 10㎡、: Four 500 lm lamps at 36°, utilization 0.7, transmittance 100%, area 10 m², distance 2 m: effective flux 1400 lm, average 140 lx; center about 1138 lx, far above the 50 lx high-sensitivity limit.
map.光源数量填 1.9：提示必须为整数，不会按 1 盏计算。: Entering 1.9 lamps: the tool requires an integer and does not calculate for one lamp.
map.光束角填 180°：提示无有限光斑，不输出无穷大或失真值。: Entering a 180° beam angle: the tool reports no finite spot and does not output infinity or a distorted value.
map.公式假设点光源、无遮光且利用系数已综合反射与维护损失，实际展柜的配光曲线、灯具位: The formulas assume a point source, no shielding and a utilization factor that already includes reflection and maintenance losses; real light distribution, lamp position and glass reflection will cause deviations. Limits follow common GB/T 23863-2009 classes; follow your institution’s specification and actual illuminance-meter readings for a specific exhibition.
map.光源数量填 1.9 会怎样？: What happens if I enter 1.9 lamps?
map.工具要求大于 0 的整数，1.9 会被拒绝并提示，不再截断成 1 盏后继续给出达: The tool requires an integer above 0; 1.9 is rejected instead of being truncated to one lamp and producing a pass.
map.光束角为什么不能到 180°？: Why can the beam angle not reach 180°?
map.180° 时半角为 90°，tan(90°) 无有限值，光斑直径与中心照度公式失: At 180° the half-angle is 90°, tan(90°) is undefined and the spot-diameter and center-illuminance formulas fail. The input maximum is 179.9°.
map.平均照度反映整体光通分摊，中心照度反映射灯峰值；点光源随距离平方衰减，局部峰值常: Average illuminance reflects flux spread over the area; center illuminance reflects the spotlight peak. Point sources fall off with distance squared, so the local peak is often much higher.
map.限值依据什么标准？: What standard are the limits based on?
map.参考 GB/T 23863-2009 的常用分级：高敏感 50 lx、低/中敏感: Common GB/T 23863-2009 classes: 50 lx for high sensitivity, 150 lx for low/medium, 300 lx for insensitive materials, with annual exposure control.
